select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, d.busi_type as busiTypeCode,/**回购类型Code**/ d.busi_type as busiType,/**回购类型**/ DECODE(d.finprod_type,'F02', 'F02orF04', 'F03', 'F03orF05', 'F04', 'F02orF04', 'F05', 'F03orF05', d.finprod_type) as finprodTypeCode,/**回购方向Code - 产品类型**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,/**交易对手**/
to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as tradeDate,/**发生日 - 取交易日期**/ to_char(d.vdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vDate,/**起息日**/ to_char(d.mdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as mDate,/*到期日*/ ftp.TERM_TYPE as termType, /** 期限品种**/ d.ccy as ccyCode, /**币种Code**/ d.ccy as ccy, /**币种**/ d.CHL_ID as chlId,/**通道**/ d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt,/** 交易本金 **/ d.PRIN_AMT as firSetAmt,/**首次结算金额**/ ftp.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, /** 回购利率(%) - 固定利率**/ d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_trade_amt as expSetAmt, /** 到期结算金额**/ d.prin_amt/ftp.prin*ftp.m_int_amt as intAmt, /** 应计利息 - 利息总额 **/ ( CASE WHEN instr('T20,T25;T21,T26', d.ps) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE NULL END ) as tranAmt,/**转入/转出利息金额**/ ( CASE WHEN instr('T27', d.ps) >0 THEN d.INT_AMT ELSE NULL END ) as divAmt,/**派息金额**/ tdf.FEE_AMT as tdFeeAmt,/**通道费**/ d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /** 交易金额 **/ d.fee_amt_pay as feeAmtPay, /*随交易支付费用*/ d.fee_amt_unpay as feeAmtUnpay,/*不随交易支付费用*/ to_char(d.pay_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') as payDate/**交付日**/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
